name: cpsc data prep

product.broker_portal: White-label importer status board and CPSC batch preparation for customs brokers

schedules.purpose: Refresh CPSC lists and template daily; the command reports changes and never releases changed rules without tests.

secrets_needed: Stripe test-mode key for checkout link generation; no live key supplied by this venture

your_steps.title: Your step: Get the trade lawyer's written opinion
your_steps.when: Before any broker contract or broker portal launch
your_steps.detail: Attach the lawyer's written confirmation that the flat-fee broker model is permitted. This approval does not sign a contract or create an account.

your_steps.title: Your step: Review and certify this CPSC batch
your_steps.when: Before a registry upload file is released
your_steps.detail: Review every extracted field beside its source page, resolve uncertain fields, and certify as the importer or licensed customs broker. Glacier never submits to CPSC.

your_steps.title: Your step: Approve the first broker contract
your_steps.when: Before the first broker is onboarded
your_steps.detail: Review and sign the broker's flat-monthly-fee contract yourself. Before offering checkout, save and verify a Stripe test-mode key in Glacier Settings → Secrets; never use a live key in this test setup. The independent second extraction uses GLACIER_OLLAMA_URL and GLACIER_LOCAL_MODEL; without both, extracted fields stay uncertain and the batch cannot be released.
